info.description: Shared-expense tracking: groups, expense splitting, balances and debt simplification
info.title: Splitwise API

post.summary: Exchange email + password for a JWT access token
Sign out of every device, this one included: every token issued so far stops working
Exchange a valid token for a fresh one in the same session (at most app.jwt.max-session)
Record an expense split EQUAL, EXACT or PERCENTAGE

delete.summary: Delete an expense (soft delete, can be restored)

get.summary: Get an expense, including a deleted one (flagged deleted=true)

put.summary: Edit an expense; send the version you read, a stale version gives 409

get.summary: The expense's history, oldest first: who added, edited (with each change) or deleted it
Groups the caller belongs to

post.summary: Create a group; the caller becomes a member

get.summary: The group's activity, newest first (members only)
Net balance per member (positive = is owed, negative = owes)
Suggested payments that settle the whole group with few transfers
The group's expenses, newest first; filter by date range, category, payer or text (q)
The group's expenses as CSV, one column per person (optional from/to, inclusive)

post.summary: Add a registered user to the group by email

delete.summary: Remove a member (creator only) or leave (your own id); the balance in the group must be zero

get.summary: Spending summary: total, per category and per member (optional from/to, inclusive)
The group's settlements, newest first, optionally within dates
Recurring expenses in my groups and the non-group ones I am part of

post.summary: Set up an expense that repeats weekly, monthly or yearly (first one today or later)

delete.summary: Stop future occurrences (expenses already created stay)

post.summary: Start a stopped or paused one again, from its next date on or after today (missed dates are skipped)
Record a payment from one user to another (settle up)

delete.summary: Undo a settlement recorded by mistake (soft delete, can be restored)

get.summary: Get a settlement, including a deleted one (flagged deleted=true)
The authenticated user's profile
Activity feed: your groups plus everything you were involved in, newest first
Overall net balance across all groups and non-group expenses (positive = owed to you)
People the user can split or settle with outside groups: shared groups or earlier non-group expenses and payments
All expenses the user paid for or has a share in
Everyone you have an open balance with, per group, plus totals (positive = owed to you)
Your balance with one friend, per group

post.summary: Record the payments that clear every open balance with a friend (one per group)
Change your password (needs the current one). Signs out every other session; returns a fresh token for this one

get.summary: All settlements the user paid or received
